title: HedeLaunch
tagline: Automating DeFi contract launches powered by PYUSD innovation.
description: We are a DeFi contract launch automation platform dedicated to unlocking the full potential of PYUSD within decentralized ecosystems. Our technology streamlines the process of deploying and managing smart contracts, making it easier for developers to integrate PYUSD into their projects. While PYUSD-based solutions have so far been more common in B2C environments, our platform bridges the gap by offering powerful tools and APIs that enable developers and businesses to create, test, and scale innovative PYUSD applications. This approach opens the door to a new B2B2C market.
how_its_made: We achieve this by creating automated scripts that enable the most common interactions with contracts using PYUSD. This allows new projects to easily and quickly test integrations by calling our scripts or replicating the base model. Additionally, we’re developing an AI system to generate MVPs of smart contracts that leverage PYUSD’s features and recommend practical use cases for testing.
